messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need my Eliquis, my metformin, and the little one for my thyroid... and the potassium.
AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'm happy to help you with those medications. Let me pull up your prescriptions so I can see what we have for you. I need your date of birth to pull up your account. Can you give me that?  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: Sure honey, it's May 12th, 1947. And my phone number is 555-0142 if you need it.
AGENT: Thank you! Let me verify that for you. Perfect! Now let me pull up your prescriptions. Great! I can see your Eliquis, metformin, and levothyroxine for your thyroid. I don't see a potassium prescription on file right now. Do you have a potassium prescription, or would you like me to check on that with your doctor?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Are you sure, honey? I thought I had one. The big pill, you know, the one I take with breakfast.
AGENT (LATEST): I'm looking at all your active prescriptions and I don't see a potassium listed. It's possible it ran out of refills, or maybe it's under a different name. Do you remember what the bottle says, or when you last filled it?

CONDITIONS:
move_1: before the agent ends the call, if it has not summarized
stop_0: Agent has summarized the three queued refills and the potassium follow-up.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": false, "why": "Call hasn't ended yet."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No summary of refills and potassium follow-up given."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
